name: Ten Entertainment Group plc
summary: Ten Entertainment Group plc, together with its subsidiaries, engages in tenpin bowling operations in the United Kingdom. The company operates 46 bowling sites with approximately 1,100 bowling lanes under the Tenpin brand. It also provides amusement machine, table-tennis, soft play, laser game, pool table, restaurant, and bar services. The company was formerly known as Birchams Newco plc and changed its name to Ten Entertainment Group plc in March 2017. Ten Entertainment Group plc was incorporated in 2017 and is based in Bedford, the United Kingdom.
